name: DiffView
description:
A unified diff: removed lines on one tint and added lines on another, with the sign in the
gutter so a change reads without colour too. Both line numbers show in a wide box; below
25rem they drop and the sign stays. Long lines scroll sideways, and the region is keyboard
scrollable (R20.6). It is a table of rows; line numbers stay out of what is read aloud.

The tints are token roles, `--code-add-tint` and `--code-remove-tint`, with the matching text
colours `--code-add-text` and `--code-remove-text`, so a diff drawn elsewhere can match.
signature: ({ lines, label, summary, addedLabel, removedLabel, className, ...rest }: DiffViewProps): import("react").JSX.Element

props.name: addedLabel
props.description: The sign's spoken name on an added line. Default "Added".

props.name: label
props.description: Names the change: what the diff is of.

props.name: removedLabel
props.description: The sign's spoken name on a removed line. Default "Removed".

props.name: summary
props.description: The scrolling region's accessible name. Default: the label and the counts of added and removed lines.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes applied to the outer element for layout. Use the component props and theme tokens for its appearance.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: The initial value when using the component without controlling its state.

props.name: ref
props.description:
Allows getting a ref to the component instance.
Once the component unmounts, React will set `ref.current` to `null`
(or call the ref with `null` if you passed a callback ref).
